items.problem: Install/status is clear, but the first 5-minute proof should explicitly connect gov-mcp install to a visible governed allow/deny demo.
items.user_impact: First user may install but not know what success looks like.
items.suggested_smallest_delta: Add a short 'First 5-minute proof' section with gov-mcp status plus MCP gov_demo/gov_check expected output.

items.problem: Bridge README has strong product story but mixes company dogfood, gov-mcp install, and Board-only gov_order flow.
items.user_impact: External user may not know whether to start with bridge-labs, Y-star-gov, gov-mcp, or K9Audit.
items.suggested_smallest_delta: Add or link a concise first external user path pointing to gov-mcp + Y-star-gov.

items.problem: Internal LAN SSE setup is useful for Labs but not safe as first external user guidance.
items.user_impact: A new user could confuse internal server instructions with product install path.
items.suggested_smallest_delta: Label as internal-only and keep external first path in owner packet/README.

items.problem: Y-star-gov has a strong ystar demo/doctor path but gov-mcp first-user path should state when the user needs ystar directly.
items.user_impact: User may not understand kernel vs execution boundary.
items.suggested_smallest_delta: Add a tiny note: if using MCP, start with gov-mcp; use ystar demo/doctor to inspect the kernel directly.

items.problem: K9Audit is compelling but should not be bundled as mandatory first install.
items.user_impact: Trying to explain four packages at once dilutes first value.
items.suggested_smallest_delta: Position as optional causal audit add-on after gov-mcp/Y-star-gov first proof.
